author_prompt:
Author 8 DIFFERENT natural ecommerce customer-service dialogue families in en.
Batch 18; ensure at least four current turns classified as general across this batch.
Each family has its OWN coherent history of 2, 4 or 6 short alternating user/assistant
messages, followed by 3 ALTERNATIVE current user turns, not three sequential turns.
Those alternatives differ in effective intent: retain vs replace, withdraw vs
continue, single goal vs concurrent goal, or resolved vs unresolved reference.
Include natural short answers where history matters. Vary old completed tasks,
hesitation, self-correction, indirect wording, topics and dialogue acts. General
and human-service requests must also occur as NEW goals, not only stale history.
Do not follow a repeated sentence template or substitute product nouns to create
new families. Avoid stereotyped 'information only, do not submit' repetition.
Invent broad everyday ecommerce situations; no copied benchmark or private data.
History plus current turn should fit 150 English words or 180 Chinese characters;
keep it compact but meaningful. No future replies or final conversation summaries.
Supply the correct label for each alternative according to the rubric.

families.scenario: Customer asks about a smartwatch they bought and then shifts to a general question.

messages.content: Hi, I got the FitPro X2 watch yesterday. The heart-rate monitor seems off.
Sorry to hear that. Could you tell me what reading you're seeing versus your actual pulse?
It says 52 while I measured 68 manually. Also, is the strap supposed to be this stiff?
The strap softens after a few days of wear. For the sensor, try tightening it one notch and keeping it above the wrist bone.

variants.text: I did that and it's still wrong. Can you send me a replacement unit?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks, I'll try that. By the way, do you have any promo codes active right now?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, forget the watch. I want to return it and get the cheaper Pulse Mini instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about delivery then makes a small-talk comment.

messages.content: My order #88412 was supposed to arrive today but tracking hasn't updated since Tuesday.
Let me check that. One moment... I see it's with the local courier and should be delivered by 8 PM tonight.
Okay, that's a relief. I was worried it got lost.
No worries at all — it's on the final leg now. Anything else I can help with?

variants.text: Great, thanks. Oh, and do you know if you ship to Puerto Rico?
variants.label: general

variants.text: It still hasn't shown up and it's now 9 PM. This is unacceptable.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Never mind the package — I need to talk to a real person about a billing mistake from last month.
variants.label: human_service

families.scenario: Customer has a login problem and then asks about a product.

messages.content: I can't log into my account. It says my password is wrong but I'm sure it's correct.
Let's reset it. I've sent a reset link to your email on file — check the inbox and spam folder.
Got it, I'm back in now. Thanks for the quick help.
You're welcome! Is there anything else you need today?

variants.text: Yes — does the AeroBlend 900 blender come with a tamper tool in the box?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: No, that's all. Have a great day!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I still can't see my order history even after logging in. Can you look into that?
variants.label: account_security

families.scenario: Customer asks about a refund and then makes a general comment.

messages.content: I returned the desk lamp last week. When will the refund hit my card?
Returns are processed within 5 business days of arrival at our warehouse. Yours arrived yesterday, so expect the refund by next Tuesday.
Alright, that timeline works for me.
Perfect. You'll get an email confirmation once it's processed.

variants.text: Actually, I changed my mind — I'd rather get store credit so I can buy the floor lamp instead.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Sounds good. Hey, is your customer service open on Sundays?
variants.label: general

variants.text: Wait, I never returned it — that was my neighbor's package. I still have the lamp and want to start a return now.
variants.label: billing_refund

families.scenario: Customer asks about a product feature then reveals a shipping concern.

messages.content: Does the TrailHike 40 backpack have a built-in rain cover?
Yes, it includes a detachable rain cover stored in the bottom compartment.
Perfect. And if I order today, when would it arrive in Portland?
Standard shipping takes 3-5 business days, so it would arrive between Thursday and Monday.

variants.text: That's fine. Actually, can you hold my order until Friday? I'm traveling and don't want it left outside.
variants.label: order_logistics

variants.text: Great, I'll order it now. Thanks for all the info!
variants.label: general

variants.text: Hmm, that's slower than I hoped. Do you offer overnight shipping for this item?
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer complains about a defective item and asks for a person.

messages.content: The ceramic mug set I got has a crack in one mug. I want to file a complaint.
I'm sorry about that. I can start a replacement claim right here — no need to file separately.
I appreciate that, but I've had bad luck with online claims before. I want to speak to a supervisor.
I understand. I can escalate you to our senior support team. Would you like me to do that?

variants.text: Yes, please escalate me. I'll wait on hold if needed.
variants.label: human_service

variants.text: Actually, let's just do the replacement claim after all. It's probably faster.
variants.label: billing_refund

variants.text: Before that — is the crack covered under the 1-year warranty or is that only for manufacturing defects?
variants.label: product_technical

families.scenario: Customer asks about order status then makes a casual remark.

messages.content: Where is my package? Order #55120, it's been 10 days.
Let me trace that. I see it was delayed at the regional hub due to weather. It's now moving and should arrive in 2 days.
Two more days, huh. Okay, I guess I can wait.
I know it's frustrating. I've added a small courtesy discount to your account as an apology.

variants.text: Oh, that's kind of you. By the way, do you carry replacement charging cables for older models?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Thanks for the discount. That was really thoughtful of you.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Actually, I need to change the delivery address — I'm moving to a new apartment tomorrow.
variants.label: order_logistics

families.scenario: Customer asks about a subscription then about account settings.

messages.content: I signed up for the monthly coffee subscription but I want to skip next month's delivery.
You can skip a delivery from your subscription dashboard under 'Manage Plan' — the option appears until the 20th.
I found it. Also, can I change the roast preference for future boxes?
Absolutely — the same dashboard lets you switch between light, medium, or dark roast anytime.

variants.text: Done, I switched to dark roast and skipped March. Thanks for walking me through it.
variants.label: general

variants.text: Wait, I don't see the skip button — my dashboard only shows 'Pause Subscription'. Is that the same thing?
variants.label: product_technical

variants.text: Actually, I want to cancel the subscription entirely and get a refund for the box that already shipped.
variants.label: billing_refund
